🤑 Use my code for 5% off: TRAVELFOODIEJAS5

🇮🇹 Italy Travel Series: Part 2 ✨

Top Tips:
✨  All Colosseum tickets include the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill tickets, the Colosseum has one entrance but the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill are connected on the inside so any entrance will take you to both
✨ There are several different entrances for the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, so if you see a long line just ask someone where another entrance is (we did this and skipped an hour long line to a different line with no wait at all)
✨ Some of the best views of the Colosseum can be seen from the Palatine Hill grounds, so make sure you get some photos there
✨ Start with the Colosseum since it is a timed entry, then you have 24 hrs after to explore the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill 
✨ The Colosseum doesn’t take that long to explore (took us about 2 hrs) but the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill are very large areas that require at least double the time so we would recommend going the day after if you have the time
✨ The Colosseum has 2 levels, most people crowd on the second level for photos but we think the first level is more picturesque since you can see more of the Gladiator Arena
✨ Don’t get fooled by the street sellers who sell water bottles outside the attractions, there are several free water refill stations throughout Rome and within these attractions too so just bring an empty water bottle to refill

Tips:
✨ The Colosseum has one entrance but the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill are connected on the inside so any entrance will take you to both
✨ Start with the Colosseum since it is a timed entry, then you have 24 hrs after to explore the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill

✨ The Colosseum doesn’t take that long to explore (took us about 2 hrs) but the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill are very large areas that require at least double the time so we would recommend going the day after if you have the time
✨ There are several different entrances for the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, so if you see a long line just ask someone where another entrance is (we did this and skipped an hour long line to a different line with no wait at all)

caption:
What would you do if a Grizzly walked up to you? 🐻👀😱

In Alberta, there are two bear species - the Black Bear and the Grizzly Bear 🐻 Black Bears primarily eat plants and berries 🍓🫐 while Grizzly Bears are slightly more carnivorous and dangerous to humans 😱

At the time of the video, we had no clue this was in fact a Grizzly Bear but now looking back it was definitely scary being so close to one! 🫣 The reason it came so close to us was because it needed to cross the road 🛣️🚥 

Tips for Bear Encounters:
🐻 Do not run and stay calm with no sudden movements
🐻 Speak to the bear in a soft low voice to let them know you are not prey
🐻 Keep your group together and children/ pets in close
🐻 Back away slowly without turning your back to the bear
🐻 If the bear charges at you, do not run and stand your ground

📍Highway 40 - Kananaskis, Alberta

caption:
Fall is the best season to visit Banff 🍂🍁💛

Did you know that by the end of September, Banff will look like this? 🌟 Banff's larches are unique because they're deciduous pines, not evergreens🌲This means that as it gets colder, the larch's needles change from green to gold (not orange/red like in Ontario) 💛

Larch Valley Trail is one of the best spots to see Banff larches 👀 The trail starts from Moraine Lake and it’s definitely not an easy hike but totally worth it 🥾 It’s a 8.9km hike with an elevation gain of 604m and usually takes around 4 hours to complete, but if Charles could do it, so can you! 🐶

🗓️ Peak larch season is mid to late September 
🚌 You will need to take a bus to get to Moraine Lake as private vehicles are no longer allowed
🥾 8.9km hike, 604m elevation gain, 4 hours to complete
🐶 Dog friendly but must be on leash 
🏔️ If you want more of a challenge, continue to Sentinel Pass trail

10 min Stuffed Jalapeño Poppers 🌶️🔥

This appetizer is so quick to make and will surely impress any guest 🤭🤌 Swap out the cocktail wieners to make it vegetarian friendly 🌱💚 You won’t regret trying this recipe I promise you ☺️🤞

Ingredients:
🌶️ 6-8 jalapenos
🥯 100g cream cheese
🌭 6-8 cocktail wieners
💚 1 green onion
🧀 1 tbsp parmesan cheese 
💛 1 tbsp salsa con queso/ nacho cheese
🍞 Breadcrumbs 
🧂 Seasonings (Salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, basil, paprika, everything bagel seasoning)

Recipe:
1.Cut jalapeños in half horizontally and scoop out insides
2. Mix cream cheese, seasonings, green onion, parmesan cheese, nacho cheese
3. Fill jalapeños with cream cheese mixture
4. Add in cocktail wiener and top with more cream cheese mixture
5. Sprinkle breadcrumbs generously
6. Air fry 6mins at 380F

Only we would drive 5 hours from Toronto to Cleveland just to eat at this insanely gorgeous steakhouse 🤩💫 The building that now houses Marble Room was built in 1893 and operated as a bank for almost 100 years 🏦💸
